label: FRA: Command the Stage in, Braid of Fire out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-09-28 (FRA set review). Command the Stage returns from the graveyard each upkeep after any turn an opponent took noncombat damage (CR 113.6m) — the pingers make that every turn — so it is a repeat spell plus a Cadet body. The pilot's reported gaps were card flow and blockers, not mana; Braid ranked last of five in Mana Banking.

label: Revert: Braid of Fire back in, Command the Stage out
author: user
rationale: Pilot asked to undo the 2026-09-28 FRA swap the same day. Restores the list to its pre-review state for these two cards; Braid of Fire returns to Mana Banking.

label: Rite of Flame in, Braid of Fire out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-10-10. Rite nets +2 red with the commander's refund, a counter and every pinger, and its mana arrives in the main phase. Braid was 5th of 5 in Mana Banking (2026-09-28): its mana arrives in the upkeep and needs Tyrant, Electro or Ashling to survive. Cost: Rite spends a card in a deck whose reported gap is draw.

label: Powerbalance in, Cosmic Cube out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-10-10. Same Free-Cast Engines job: Powerbalance gives about 0.63 free spells per turn cycle from turn 2, and each hit is a counter, {R} and every pinger, on opponents' turns. Cosmic Cube costs 5 and needs an attack; it picks the best of six and can cast Chandra's Ignition free, which is what is lost. Reveal cost: each trigger shows the table your next draw.

label: b4 wave 1: fast mana and a 28-land base
author: user
rationale: Turn-2 commander: colourless fast mana pays her {2}, zero-cost artifacts are free spells once she is out. Lands 32 to 28. Grounds per swap in research/proposal.json wave-1 (2026-10-13).

label: b4 wave 2: the combo package
author: user
rationale: Loops where her {R} refund is a piece (Grinning Ignus, Reiterate + Seething Song, Breach + LED + Wheel, Haze + Storm-Kiln) plus Dualcaster + Molten Duplication, which needs no commander. Verified by mtg-rules-expert 2026-10-13, ledger loop-018 to loop-022.

label: b4 wave 3: tutors and card flow
author: user
rationale: Find two or three specific cards by turn 3: Gamble and Imperial Recruiter, spellslinger's draw (Vision of Love, Thrill, Wiccan), Unexpected Windfall, Wrenn's Resolve and two free cantrips. Grounds in research/proposal.json wave-3.

label: b4 wave 4: protection and interaction
author: user
rationale: Champion's Helm duplicates Swiftfoot Boots' hexproof at a higher cost; Mithril Coat insures against wraths that cost this list only a recast. Untimely Malfunction and Pyroblast answer on the combo turn.

label: Impact Tremors in, Wiccan out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-10-14. A recast Grinning Ignus is a new object entering (CR 400.7, 603.6a), so Tremors turns the Ignus loop into damage, and it makes the Dualcaster tokens a no-combat kill. Kit simulation: complete combo by turn 4 33% to 35%. Wiccan was four mana and the pilot had called it too slow for Scarlet Witch's b4.

label: Infantry Shield in, Treasonous Ogre out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-10-14: life is harder to spare at Bracket 4 tables. Infantry Shield gives her mobilize X equal to her power, so after an Ignus loop she attacks with as many 1/1 Warriors as you chose, split between opponents (CR 702.181a, 508.4), and Impact Tremors pings for each. Kit simulation 34.8% to 36.5% by turn 4. Lost: Ogre's life-to-mana that started a Reiterate loop.

label: b3-tokens wave 1: the token engine
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-10-14. Impact Tremors and Purphoros turn every creature entering into damage; Young Pyromancer and Stormsplitter make tokens on every instant or sorcery (Stormsplitter doubles, ledger zone-028). Cuts are slow engines on the pilot's list and the weakest converter. Grounds in research/proposal-b3-tokens.json wave-1.

label: b3-tokens wave 2: voltron that makes tokens
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-10-14. She grows herself, so Infantry Shield (mobilize X equal to her power, ledger equip-029) replaces the pure growth Equipment Blackblade Reforged; Empty the Warrens is a storm finisher that leaves an army, over the fourth red-banking card.

label: Goblin Bombardment in, Firebrand Archer out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-10-14 (wave 3). Sacrifice Infantry Shield Warriors and Stormsplitter copies, which leave at end step anyway, for 1 damage each (3 under Fiery Emancipation). Firebrand Archer was the most fragile remaining pinger; Kessig Flamebreather does the same job as a 1/3.

label: Hordeling Outburst in, Forge of Heroes out
author: user
rationale: Pilot approved 2026-10-14 (wave 3). Three Goblins from a sorcery that also fires Guttersnipe, Young Pyromancer and Stormsplitter; Forge of Heroes gave one counter the turn she lands. Lands 32 to 31.

label: Laughing Mad in, Crash Through out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call 2026-11-10 (plays main most: 'probably main'). Flashback makes Laughing Mad two casts from one card: two Vision triggers ({R} and a +1/+1 counter each) and two triggers on every converter, for one net card over the two casts. Crash Through was the cantrip whose rider (team trample) does least for a flying commander. Card Draw 6 to 7, Cantrips 6 to 5. The gameplan names cards in hand as the binding constraint, and the first play report said the deck struggles with draw.
